run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute maximum profit by buying and selling a share at most twice
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple stock price arrays to verify correct maximum profit calculation
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses dynamic programming with forward and backward passes to find max profit
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like negative prices or single element arrays
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to accept the price list length automatically instead of requiring an explicit n parameter
